Date: Capital Gains Tax summary: cryptoassets, tax year 6 April 2025 to 5 April 2026
Gains in the year, before losses (box 13.4)
Tax if all within the basic rate band

A disposal is a token's disposals of one day, matched with that day's acquisitions, then with those of the next 30 days (earliest first), then the section 104 pool; the days are your local calendar days. Losses brought forward (box 45) and gains on other assets are not applied here; the annual exempt amount and losses are shared with them. Which rate applies depends on your income. File SA108 when your proceeds exceed £50,000, your gains exceed the annual exempt amount, or you have a loss to claim. Lost or stolen coins are no disposal: a negligible value claim on the whole pool is yours to make. Income is at its market value on receipt; airdrops are listed apart (an airdrop not given for a service may cost £0: s. 17(2)). A fee row booked apart from any trade is a disposal of its coins, not a cost of a trade. Fiat currency held abroad is a chargeable asset not computed here.
